traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Barbeyaceae: leaves opposite; leaves simple; margins entire; veins pinnate; blades lanceolate; stipules absent; plants dioecious; ovary superior; floral cup absent; stems woody; flowers in cymes; flowers actinomorphic; perianth tepals; fruit nut; stamens 6 to 9 (-12); carpels 1 to 3. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
